description: This Java source file defines a utility class 'Utils' for parsing and handling date/time strings, matching regex patterns in text, and providing constants related to UTC timezone and regex patterns for date-time formats.

classes.name: Utils
classes.description: A utility class providing methods for date/time parsing, regex matching utilities, and constants related to time formatting.

methods.name: matches
methods.description: Checks if the provided text matches the regex pattern using the given Matcher, and resets the matcher for subsequent use.

methods.name: match
methods.description: Returns a Matcher if the text matches the pattern; otherwise, returns null. Resets the matcher with the text.

methods.name: getInt
methods.description: Extracts an integer from a regex match group, or returns a default value if the group is null or empty.

methods.name: parseCalendar
methods.description: Parses date/time components from a regex Matcher and constructs a GregorianCalendar object, optionally including milliseconds.
